topic.label: Stocks and Equities
topic.desc: Shares in companies: common and preferred stock, fundamental and technical analysis, corporate actions, and reading company filings.

concepts: Common and preferred stock, share classes, voting rights, dividends and ADRs.
Valuing a stock from its business: earnings, ratios, growth, margins and multiples.
Price and volume patterns, moving averages, momentum and indicators, and their limits.
Splits, dividends, buybacks, spinoffs, tender offers and their effect on shareholders.
10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, 13F and insider Form 4 filings.
skills: Explains a company's share classes, voting rights and dividend terms.
Summarizes a stock's fundamentals: revenue, earnings, margins, valuation multiples and peers.
Reads an earnings release and summarizes results versus expectations.
Computes technical indicators for a price series and states what they do and do not show.
Explains a corporate action and its effect on a holder's shares and cost basis.
Read a 10-K annual filing and extract business, risk factors, MD&A and key financials.
Tracks insider Form 4 trades and institutional 13F holdings for a company.
mcp: SEC EDGAR MCP server: company filings, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financial data and insider trading forms from EDGAR.
Yahoo Finance MCP server: stock prices, historical quotes, company financial statements, holders, options chains and news.
Financial Datasets MCP server: company income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, stock prices and market news.
